title: Onewheel Battery Sag After Firmware Updates
dataSources: Rides (`ride:session`), charge sessions (`ride:charge`), ride exports (`ride:export`), surf forecasts (`surf:forecast`), ride incidents (`ride:incident`), segment efforts (`fitness:segment`).
app: Micro-mobility and action-sports telemetry — Onewheel ride exports, legacy Boosted board logs, Surfline forecast snapshots, and Strava segment efforts — streamed to Splunk HEC via vendor exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ride:session platform="onewheel" firmware_version=* battery_sag_pct=*
| stats avg(battery_sag_pct) as avg_battery_sag_pct, count as events by firmware_version
| sort - avg_battery_sag_pct
description: Shows average battery sag percentage by firmware version for Onewheel rides.
value: Average battery sag percentage by firmware version helps compare Onewheel rides across the factors that matter most.
implementation: Capture `battery_sag_pct` on `ride:session` events and normalize `firmware_version` so Splunk can summarize performance by firmware version.
visualization: Bar chart of average battery sag percentage by firmware version.
grandmaExplanation: It lists the average battery sag percentage for each firmware version so you can see what works best for Onewheel rides.
